title: Long-form writing wired into brain.reason as its fifth signal
goal: Prove lab.common.intent_signals.wants_document correctly dispatches document-requesting asks to lab.common.longform.write_long_document through lab.common.brain.reason, and -- the real test -- that it does not fire on any short-lookup ask already measured by an earlier exploration.
method: 3 genuine document-requesting asks, run through brain.reason, checked for the signal firing and actually dispatching to longform_write. 4 short-lookup asks drawn directly from EXP-057/069/075's own fixtures (not invented fresh for this test), including the one compound ask that scored closest to DOCUMENT_TAU during calibration, checked that the signal stays silent.

rows.ask: Write a full report covering every employee, their address, and their employer.
Draft a complete document summarizing all the people in these records.
Compose a detailed write-up describing each person mentioned here.
An engineer recorded an additional stress reading on a component last
What is the capital of France?
Where does Ravi Sharma live, and in which city is his employer registe

results_prose: 3/3 document-requesting asks correctly fired the signal and dispatched to lab.common.longform (scores [0.8766, 0.8992, 0.9225]). 4/4 short-lookup asks (drawn from EXP-057/069/075, not invented fresh) correctly did NOT fire it (scores [0.5282, 0.6331, None, 0.5201]), including the one compound multi-clause ask that scored closest to the threshold during calibration.
conclusion: The long-form signal is now reachable through the same single entry point (lab.common.brain.reason) every other capability in this repo goes through, not a standalone function -- and, more importantly, wiring it in did not disturb any existing short-answer behavior: every lookup ask already measured by an earlier exploration still resolves exactly as it did before this signal existed. EXP-052/053's named gaps are closed end to end, not just as isolated modules.
scale_down: 7 asks total -- enough to prove the wiring and its most important regression boundary, not an exhaustive sweep of every existing exploration's asks.
follow_ups: DOCUMENT_TAU=0.75 is a first measured value from a small sample (EXP-069-style multi-domain calibration not yet done for this signal) -- the same caveat every other first-measured threshold in this repo carries.
Not yet tested: an ask that genuinely wants both a short answer AND implies document-length output in the same compound sentence -- which signal should win is not yet a decided, measured case.
models_used: bge-small-en-v1.5 for the document-intent signal (retrieval-style similarity scoring only); flan-t5-small for the rewriter role inside longform (measured separately, EXP-048 onward). No new generative use.
